expected.insightNarrative:
Employee Churn is the churn page of the HR Workforce accelerator for Salesforce: which organizations and departments were the most impacted by employee churn over the last twelve months, from Dec-21 to Dec-22, and which require special attention because of a high churn risk. The filters at the top are set to the current month Dec, the current year 2022, and All for department, nationality, gender and organization.

Key insights
- The employee churn rate is 27.2% on an average headcount of 389.2, with (106) leavers and +59 starters over the last 12 months.
- DE Subsidiary's Production department is the most affected team: 26 leavers in the last 12 months on the largest average headcount, 94.2. US Subsidiary's Sales department is the other large team, with an average headcount of 46.5.
- Hiring was strongest in DE Subsidiary's Client Services and Holding's General Management, each with +5 starters in the last 12 months.
- Over the period, starters peaked in May 2021 with +42 (a net +35 after leavers), leavers peaked in September 2022 with -23, and FTE fell to its lowest at 344 in November 2022 and 336 in December 2022.

Employee Churn KPIs, Perf - Analyzed Period for 12 months
The employee churn rate is 27.2% on an average headcount of 389.2, with (106) leavers and +59 starters, computed on the last 12 months, from Dec-21 to Dec-22.

Dept/Org - Churn Risk
ACTUAL CHURN: which organizations and departments were the most impacted by employee churn. A grid of organizations (DE Subsidiary, US Subsidiary, Holding, PT Subsidiary, SP Subsidiary, Optys Corp., CH Subsidiary) by department (Production, Sales, General Management, ICT, Client Services, Marketing, Procurement, Finance, Quality Department, Board of Advisors, Real Estate, Human Resources, Research & Development) shows one square per team, sized by leavers and coloured by churn rate. The largest loss is DE Subsidiary Production with 26 leavers on an average headcount of 94.2; US Subsidiary Finance lost 9, Holding Marketing 9, Holding General Management 8, Holding Research & Development 7, Holding ICT 6 and SP Subsidiary Real Estate 6; most other teams lost between one and five people. DE Subsidiary Client Services and Holding General Management each gained 5 starters, and US Subsidiary Sales has an average headcount of 46.5.

Employee per Dept/Org - Churn Risk
UPCOMING CHURN RISK: which organizations and departments require special attention because of a high churn risk. The same organizations by department, one circle per employee coloured by churn risk, where concentrations of red dots mark teams with a high churn risk. The largest teams are DE Subsidiary Production, US Subsidiary Supply Chain and Sales, and PT Subsidiary Production; the orange dots that flag risk are concentrated in DE Subsidiary Production and Quality Department, Holding General Management, Marketing and Finance, and SP Subsidiary General Management and Real Estate.

Starters and Leavers Evolution
The month-by-month evolution of starters, leavers and FTE behind the page: starters peaked in May 2021 with +42 (a net +35 after leavers), leavers peaked in September 2022 with -23, and FTE fell to 344 in November 2022 and 336 in December 2022, the lowest of the period.
